description.p: Eduka-Customizer builds live images of your own Debian-based distribution from Debian stable, testing, sid or a derivative such as LMDE, step by step: extract an ISO or bootstrap a new base, choose the desktop or window manager in a Mini, Compact, Full or Full-with-apps edition (GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce, Cinnamon, MATE, LXQt, Eduka-Desktop, i3, Sway and more), install packages and Flatpak apps, replace the default applications, brand the boot splash, login screen and boot menu, check the image and build a hybrid BIOS/UEFI ISO.
